title: Authorized Claim Amounts and Repair-Related Reimbursements — Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
These are the payment rules of Vehicle Service Contracts for an authorized repair: what the authorized amount may include, the lifetime claim limit, the deductible, how the repair facility is paid, and the towing, rental, trip interruption and roadside benefits.

### A. What an authorized amount pays

The authorized amount is the covered parts, labor and diagnosis authorized before the deductible. It:

- pays labor at no more than the plan's labor rate cap per hour;
- includes teardown and diagnosis when the failure is covered;
- includes seals and gaskets replaced in a covered repair only where the plan covers seals and gaskets;
- may not take the claims paid above the plan's lifetime claim limit.

### B. Claims paid

The claims paid on a service contract are, over the life of that service contract, the total of each authorized claim's authorized amount less the deductible charged on it.

*Hypothetical example.* Two authorized claims on one service contract: 1200.00 authorized with a 100.00 deductible, and 650.00 authorized with a 100.00 deductible. The claims paid are 1100.00 plus 550.00, which is 1650.00. Any further authorized amount may not take that total above the lifetime claim limit.

### C. Deductible and payment to the facility

The borrower pays the plan's deductible once per repair visit, whatever the number of covered components repaired, and the administrator pays the repair facility the rest.

| Hypothetical repair visit | Authorized amount | Deductible paid by the borrower | Paid by the administrator to the facility |
|---|---|---|---|
| One covered component repaired | 1200.00 | 100.00 | 1100.00 |
| Three covered components repaired on the same visit | 2400.00 | 100.00 (charged once) | 2300.00 |

### D. Towing, rental, trip interruption and roadside assistance

Towing up to the plan's towing amount, rental at the plan's daily rental amount for up to the plan's maximum rental days, and trip interruption up to the plan's trip interruption amount are reimbursed only with an authorized repair; plans that include roadside assistance also provide 24-hour roadside assistance.

| Request | Reimbursed when | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Towing | there is an authorized repair | up to the plan's towing amount |
| Rental | there is an authorized repair | the plan's daily rental amount, for up to the plan's maximum rental days |
| Trip interruption | there is an authorized repair | up to the plan's trip interruption amount |

*Hypothetical case.* A tow is billed for a breakdown whose repair claim is denied: with no authorized repair, the tow is not reimbursed.
